items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Emmett Berry was with us quite awhile.

ctx.x: Well did Shorty Baker play very long with the group? I don't remember --
Berry played quite awhile. Emmett Berry. Emmett Berry was with us quite awhile. Yes, Shorty was in the last group. He was terrific. Very, very good.
And you had (inaudible) the one hit records
